fm.title: Dds middleware
fm.description: OMG Data Distribution Service (DDS) publish-subscribe middleware blocks (2 blocks)

rows.intent: Read a data sample from a DDS (Data Distribution Service) topic — use to subscribe to real-time distributed data in systems that communicate over OMG DDS middleware
Publish a data sample to a DDS (Data Distribution Service) topic — use to broadcast real-time data from Simulink to other DDS participants in a distributed system
